schema:name: Coffee Washing Channel, Honduras
schema:description:
This image shows green coffee beans in a washing channel, as part of the washing process. The washing process removes the sticky mucilage surrounding the coffee beans that remains after pulping (removing the fruit or cascara). Washed beans are known for having a "clean" flavor when compared to naturally processed beans.

Hacienda La Minita serves as Distant Lands Coffee’s green coffee trading division, sourcing coffee from Honduras as part of its international coffee trade.
